# Roman Grishin

> Product designer for B2B and B2C, 7+ years of experience, now at MightyCall. A portfolio with case studies and results.

- [Full portfolio text](https://grisroman.space/en/llms-full.txt): experience, all case studies with results, contacts
- [Home](https://grisroman.space/en/)
- [Predictive dialer case study](https://grisroman.space/en/cases/predictive-dialer/): agent occupancy up from 40% to 78%
- [Firefighter case study](https://grisroman.space/en/cases/firefighter/): crew turnaround time calculated in 47 seconds instead of 6 minutes
- [Butler case study](https://grisroman.space/en/cases/butler/): a home management platform with an intercom, an app, and an admin panel in 17,011 apartments across 27 complexes
